scripts.serve: bun run build && bun run --cwd packages/server start
scripts.typecheck: bun x tsc --noEmit -p packages/core && bun x tsc --noEmit -p packages/server && bun x tsc --noEmit -p packages/mcp && bun x tsc --noEmit -p packages/web
scripts.db:reset: rm -f data/board.db data/board.db-wal data/board.db-shm && bun run --cwd packages/server migrate
